payload.claim: `_reviewed_tree` restates the sha256 computation that `saffron.agents.artifacts.hash_artifact` already defines (`hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()`), the exact function `session.py` uses to produce the `sha256` field being checked here.
